brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu opened his Likud party's election campaign Thursday, declaring that the "mission must be completed" across three fronts, Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu claimed that he and his party "are the only ones" capable of prosecuting the military operations, without providing specifics on what completion would entail.

The remarks signal Netanyahu's intention to continue military engagement in Gaza, where an Israeli offensive has persisted for months, as well as escalating tensions with Lebanon and Iran.

title: Netanyahu vows to complete military missions in Iran, Lebanon, Gaza
